question: Which Indian athlete won the bronze medal in Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) at the Asian Youth Games 2025 in Bahrain?
solution:
The correct answer is __**"Veer Bhadu"**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Veer Bhadu won India's first-ever bronze medal in Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) at the Asian Youth Games in Bahrain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Veer Bhadu won the bronze medal in the Men's 80 kg category by defeating Thailand's Dechachot Barisri by unanimous decision.
 
• Palash Mandal also secured a bronze medal in the boys' 5000 metre walk race at the same event.
 
• India's total medal tally at the Asian Youth Games is now 12, with 2 gold, 3 silver, and 7 bronze medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Veer's victory in MMA marked a historic moment as it was India's first medal in this sport at the Asian Youth Games.
 
• The Asian Youth Games are a multi-sport event where athletes from across Asia compete in various disciplines.
